title: Native mass spectrometry reveals DltA catalysis, DltC loading, and inhibition in the D-alanylation pathway
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29834-29843
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA04213A, Paper

Yi Wang, Hannah Squires, Marian Aba Addo, Jospeh P. Gerdt, Tarick J. El-Baba, R. Craig MacLean, Carol V. Robinson, Jani R. Bolla
Gram-positive bacteria protect their cell envelope by D-alanylating lipoteichoic acid (LTA). DltA activates D-alanine and loads it onto holo-DltC, which works with DltB, DltX and DltD to transfer D-alanine onto LTA.
